metaDescription: K&M Kitchen Renovations won Toronto's 2026 award. See its White Shaker cabinet work, two-week kitchen timelines and basement kitchen projects.
summary: K&M Kitchen Renovations delivers kitchen renovations, bathroom remodels and basement finishing across Toronto, Hamilton, London and Woodstock. With over 10 years of combined team experience, the company completes most kitchen projects in as little as two weeks.

editorial.heading: What They Do
editorial.text: K&M Kitchen Renovations handles full kitchen overhauls with White Shaker cabinet installation, custom kitchen cabinets, bathroom remodels, and basement finishing that extends to basement kitchens and secondary bathrooms. That range means the company can be hired for a single kitchen project or a broader basement suite renovation that includes a kitchenette. Ten-plus years of combined team experience sits behind the work.

editorial.heading: How They Work
editorial.text: The company advertises completing most kitchen projects in as little as two weeks, a notably fast timeline for a full renovation and worth confirming against the specific scope of any individual job. Cabinet installation centres on White Shaker style, a widely popular profile, rather than a broad range of door styles. Basement finishing work extends the company's scope into secondary suites and bathrooms beyond the kitchen itself.

editorial.heading: What Homeowners Say
editorial.text: One reviewer said the company completely transformed their outdated 1990s kitchen with White Shaker cabinets that look incredible, finishing ahead of schedule, and said they had already recommended the company to three neighbours. Another described the experience from first quote to final reveal as seamless and said their new kitchen increased their home's value significantly.

editorial.heading: Where They Work
editorial.text: K&M Kitchen Renovations serves the GTA and Southwestern Ontario, including Toronto, Hamilton, London and Woodstock. Homeowners outside these named cities should confirm coverage before requesting a quote.

strengths: Advertises completing most kitchen projects in as little as two weeks.
Combines kitchen, bathroom and basement finishing under one contractor.
Specializes in White Shaker cabinet installation, a widely requested style.
Serves a wide footprint across the GTA and Southwestern Ontario.
considerations: A two-week timeline is a general figure and may not apply to larger or more complex kitchen layouts.
Cabinet work centres on White Shaker style, so ask directly if you want a different door profile.
As with any renovation contractor, confirm permit requirements for basement kitchen or bathroom additions.
bestFor: Homeowners wanting a fast full kitchen renovation
Anyone specifically wanting White Shaker cabinetry
Basement kitchen or secondary bathroom conversions
Combined kitchen and bathroom remodel projects
questionsToAsk: What kitchen layouts or scopes typically fit within the two-week timeline you advertise?
Are permits required for a basement kitchen or secondary bathroom, and who handles that process?
What cabinet door styles and finishes are available beyond White Shaker?
What is the payment schedule, and what deposit is required to start?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: It means K&M Kitchen Renovations was selected as the top business in the Kitchen Remodeling category for Toronto through an independent editorial review of public information and customer feedback. No business pays a fee to be selected.

faq.q: Can they finish a basement, not just a kitchen?
faq.a: Yes. Basement finishing, including basement kitchens and secondary bathrooms, is listed alongside kitchen and bathroom remodeling.

faq.q: How fast is a typical kitchen renovation?
faq.a: The company advertises completing most kitchen projects in as little as two weeks, though actual timelines depend on the specific scope of work.
K&M Kitchen Renovations serves the GTA and Southwestern Ontario, including Toronto, Hamilton, London and Woodstock.
